svg.title: Q&A Pair Generator — Llm · Edtech
svg.desc: Q&A Pair Generator: Turns PDFs or notes into ready-to-use assessments (MCQ, true/false, fill-in-the-blank) with verified answers. Runs 100% locally via Ollama. Built with Python, Ollama, Streamlit.
